verdict.rationale: An official registry portal could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no such resource. Both mca.gov.in and the National Single Window return HTTP 403 to automated agents at robots.txt, and nothing beyond robots.txt was fetched, so an agent could not be pointed at any agent docs there. Confidence is medium because the probes recorded the wall but never checked an llms.txt path directly.
